metadata.study: Oracle comparison of Minesweeper action economy
metadata.firstClickPolicy: zero-safe corner: clicked cell and its three neighbors excluded from mine placement
metadata.generator: Mulberry32 with Fisher-Yates shuffle via Math.floor(rng*(i+1)); finite PRNG precision applies
metadata.information: All policies know every mine and zero component. Results measure click mechanics, not a solver or player under uncertainty.
metadata.actions: 1 per left reveal, flag placement, or chord. No no-op or unflag actions; random-safe can reveal opening borders prematurely. Flags are charged when placed, even if reused.
metadata.ciMethod: Paired board differences, sample mean ± 1.96 sample standard error; an approximate sampling interval under the generator.

paired.comparator: greedy-chord minus opening-first on identical boards
